message: The other day, I caught myself double-checking our smoke alarms for the third time this month. I know, I know—I might be the gloriously over-prepared neighbor in the cul-de-sac. 😅 But honestly, it’s just nice to feel a little more at ease, especially with all the cooking I've been experimenting with. I even made a fire escape plan with the kids, which turned into a fun little game! Sometimes being ready just means being a bit more relaxed about the unexpected. How do you keep your home safe?
